# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Transportation and Warehousing | Micro: Freight forwarding office

| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** USCG Maritime Cybersecurity Rule, 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F
**Why:** It is the only codified, publicly available, prescriptive cybersecurity regulation in the transportation sector (TSA SDs are time-limited directives, partly SSI, and the TSA surface NPRM is not final). It enumerates concrete controls (MFA, encryption, logging, segmentation, pen testing, IR plan, training) with fixed compliance dates, making it an ideal gap-analysis target for ports, terminals and marine logistics; rail/pipeline operators should map to the TSA SDs (see c-transportation).

**Applicability check first:** at this size the business is a freight forwarding and customs brokerage office. Decide whether USCG Maritime Cybersecurity Rule applies directly or only through contracts. If it does not apply, analyze the regulation that governs this business, and record the reasoning.
